chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'A brother from the father, and the grandfather?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The wealth is between the two of them, equally'.

key_terms.أَخٌ لِأَبٍ: Paternal brother (full brother sharing both father and mother)

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between a grandfather and a full brother?
ai.summary: In this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the concept of 'equal standing' (sawa') is applied to the inheritance shares of a full paternal brother and the grandfather, resolving potential precedence disputes in the absence of closer heirs. This hadith is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for establishing that the grandfather does not exclude the brother, nor vice versa, but rather they share the residue equally, reflecting a distinct approach from some Sunni schools that may prioritize the grandfather. The ruling underscores the principle of equity among male agnatic heirs when no direct descendants or parents are present.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A brother from the father, and the grandfather?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is between the two of them, equally’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a brother from a father and grandfather. He (the Imam) said, ‘The legacy between them is distributed in equal shares.’”
